title: Code and data for: Reported POPE gains are mostly template artifacts
description: Analysis code and result files for an audit of object-hallucination mitigation and evaluation on POPE. The release includes per-item model outputs, flip decomposition, McNemar tests, bootstrap intervals, CHAIR analysis, PAS detection reproduction, label-noise analysis, and figure-generation scripts. Code is MIT-licensed; derived result files and figures are CC BY 4.0.
